global_caption: The video contains 4 shots. It is a realistic low-saturation urban advertisement short film, using cool neutral tones and a subtle hazy texture, primarily lit by natural overcast daylight, supplemented by cold light edges from building screens and window reflections. The camera movement is controlled and fluid, progressing from observation to following, then focusing and releasing. No
shot1: Shot 1 begins with a hard cut from black, wide eye-level composition. The crosswalk is positioned in the lower third of the frame, the girl with a backpack stands slightly left of center. Foreground features softly blurred curb and pedestrian shadows; midground includes the crosswalk and waiting zone; background consists of low-saturation building facades and a large LED screen. Moderate depth of field allows both subject and screen to be clearly visible. The setting is an early morning school commute urban intersection, air slightly cool, traffic subdued. Lighting is dominated by diffused natural light, with faint ground reflections from the screen's cold glow. The girl stops at the crosswalk, tilting her head up slightly, body stabilizing after stepping. Her backpack straps sway gently. Dynamic charts on the screen burst open as if instantly activated by the city system—lines rapidly expand outward from the center, dense labels “通学效率+32%” appear as semi-transparent glowing text in the upper central area, modern, narrow, cold white with pale cyan outlines, accompanied by expanding motion effects and slight particle dispersion. Traffic continues at realistic speed across the frame. distant mechanical The camera slowly pushes in, emphasizing the moment she first connects with urban information.
shot2: Shot 2 connects to previous shot via hard cut, medium side-rear tracking shot, eye-level angle. The girl occupies the right third of the frame. The scene naturally transitions to the bus stop ahead. Lighting remains overcast natural light with cold reflections from glass. She resumes walking, pace steady, backpack swaying rhythmically. As she passes the bus stop glass, rotating pie charts and circular data scales appear as if adhered between the glass surface and reflected world, shifting with parallax as she moves. Text “安全”“覆盖” enters sequentially from the left side of the glass like layered semi-transparent stickers, arranged vertically along the glass structure, with a slight matte texture and edge glow. Their entrance effect starts blurry, solidifies, then gently locks in place. As she passes, charts briefly overlay her silhouette, creating a sense of ad content embedded within daily commute. Sparse pedestrians move slowly behind the platform but remain unobtrusive. Camera performs smooth lateral tracking with slight forward motion, enhancing natural integration of character movement and graphic overlay.
shot3: Shot 3 connects to previous shot via brief fade cut, near-to-close-up eye-level push-in. Composition focuses on the girl’s eyes and half-face. Foreground features slightly out-of-focus shop window frame; focus locked on her gaze; background compressed into reflective urban textures. Scene follows her to a storefront window. Lighting remains subdued and realistic, only allowing cold window light to create soft highlights around her eyes. The window surface under her gaze transforms into a high-speed-refreshing data wall, small numbers, arrows, and coordinate axes continuously updating from edges toward center. Data elements are rendered as semi-transparent fine lines and cold white pixel light, refresh pattern involving rapid scrolling, pause, then jump-change—resembling real HUD while maintaining commercial restraint. This shot emphasizes cognitive focus, suggesting she sees not just scenery, but interpreted urban data. Distant automatic door opening Camera slowly pushes from close-up to extreme close-up, pausing briefly on the highlight in her pupil.
shot4: Shot 4 connects to previous shot via match cut from bright area, wide aerial overhead view from an overpass looking down at intersecting traffic lanes. The girl stands in the lower-middle portion of the frame, facing away. Urban roads form strong leading lines. Foreground features metal railing and her static back; midground shows continuous vehicle flow; background includes low-saturation buildings and distant mall entrance. Deep depth of field preserves full city structure. Lighting remains consistent overcast natural light, with cold reflections on vehicles blending with digital layers. She stands still, backpack strap and clothing edges gently fluttering in the breeze. Chart elements from below begin converging from all directions into continuous data lines, extracted from lanes, building screens, window reflections, and bus stop glass, merging centrally at the top of the frame into a massive title “看见城市脉搏”. Text is horizontally centered, occupying the upper core area of the frame, modern bold font with metallic matte texture and cold white edge glow. Entrance effect involves countless thin lines retracting and converging before final freeze-frame. Electronic atmosphere briefly lifts at title freeze, then quickly fades, perfectly synchronized with the final image. Camera performs extremely slow upward rise with slight pull-back, fully releasing the urban scale at the end.
